result.title: WhatIf: Counterfactual World Models over Action-Grounded Causal Graphs for Robotic Manipulation
result.summary: World models predict what happens under an action, but choosing between actions requires comparing their outcomes in the same physical situation. Factual transitions alone determine action-wise marginal futures and average effects, but not individual effects or the probability that switching actions causes harm. We introduce WhatIf, a counterfactual world model for manipulation that couples candidate futures through shared latent physics and transition noise inferred from factual history. Each candidate action induces a sparse object-factor causal graph describing the physical pathways it activates. Rolling out these graphs under the shared situation anchors predictions to observed outcomes and confines action contrasts to the objects each action reaches. Shared type-conditioned functions support varying numbers of objects, while a round-trip loss enforces action-invariant abduction without counterfactual labels. We show that replacing an individual effect with its conditional mean incurs mean-squared error equal to its conditional variance, motivating comparisons between coupled futures. Building on these comparisons, Counterfactual Advantage Planning (CAP) ranks plans by their advantage over an incumbent within shared situations and constrains the probability of harm. Paired advantages reduce estimator variance by a factor of $1-ρ$, where $ρ$ is the correlation between branch outcomes, and cancel model errors shared by both branches. Each executed transition provides hindsight advantages to update the physics posterior, the next plan, and an amortized policy without a learned critic. We further establish when observational transitions identify interventional dynamics. Paired simulator interventions evaluate counterfactual accuracy, graph recovery, compositional generalization, and decision quality.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 WhatIf 反事实世界模型：用共享 latent physics 和从事实历史推断的转移噪声耦合多个候选未来，每个动作诱导稀疏的物体因子因果图，并以 round-trip 损失在无反事实标签下训练动作不变的 abduction，再据此做反事实优势规划。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「共享 latent 状态下多分支耦合展开 + 无标签一致性损失」可供核查是否能迁移到 LVR 的 latent 假设比较、分支间共享信息的贡献分配与 latent 状态监督；但该工作属机器人操作与世界模型领域，与视觉语言推理的距离较远，可迁移性待验证。
